title: Projection-formula isomorphisms are closed under triangles
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category with monoidal preadditivity and functorial flat resolutions, and assume etale upper star preserves flat objects. For any morphism p : X → Y, any M in D(X_et,A), and any distinguished triangle T in D(Y_et,A), if the projection-map components at T.obj₁ and T.obj₂ are isomorphisms, then the component at T.obj₃ is an isomorphism. The derived categories and canonical functors are as in [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-kun-projection-formula-map].

source.place: Property (2) in the proof; Tag 014A, third-isomorphism theorem

proof.text: Give derived pushforward its right-adjoint shift structure and derived pullback the shift structure transported from exact inverse image. The derived adjunction commutes with these structures. For the tensor comparison, prove shift compatibility on a K-flat homotopy representative using its defining counit factorization; functorial flat resolution and invariance under isomorphism extend the calculation to every derived object. The generic projection-map shift theorem then makes the canonical projection map commute with shift.

Tensor, exact derived pullback, and its right adjoint are triangulated. The components of the projection transformation define a morphism between the images of T under the two triangulated functors; the third square follows from shift compatibility and naturality. Apply the third-isomorphism theorem to the first two component isomorphisms.

theorem projection_triangle_isIso [UpperStarPreservesFlat A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A))
    (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology A)))
    (ht : T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles)
    (h₁ : IsIso (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap A p).app M).app T.obj₁))
    (h₂ : IsIso (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap A p).app M).app T.obj₂)) :
    IsIso (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap A p).app M).app T.obj₃)
